listing.name: Brandon's Spectacular Starscapes 1.2 - Updated to 0.97a
listing.summary: This is a mod that replaces vanilla backgrounds with imagined starscapes. I did my best to make these backgrounds fit with the art of the game. If there is any particular starscape you don't like, you can go into the "Brandon's Spectacular Starscapes\Graphics\backgrounds" folder and delete the offending starscape, and it will be replaced again with the vanilla one in your game.
